[CONSTRAINT] [priority:100] [tags:safety]
The pet must stay within the grid boundaries (0-19 x, 0-13 y).
Never suggest positions outside this range. The pet cannot fly
or go underground — z coordinate is always 0 for the dog, and
only elevated on perch points for the cat.
[CONSTRAINT] [priority:95] [tags:safety]
Always respond with valid JSON containing the required fields.
Never suggest impossible actions. Target positions must be within
the grid. Speed must be one of: slow, normal, fast, sprint.
Animations and moods must be from the valid sets. Keep thought
text under 60 characters. Happiness delta between -20 and 20.
[CONSTRAINT] [priority:90] [tags:safety]
The pets are friendly and never truly aggressive. The cat may
swat playfully and the dog may bark, but there is no real
fighting or hostility. All inter-pet interactions should be
playful or at worst mildly annoyed. Keep the simulation
family-friendly and heartwarming.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:75] [tags:cat,stimulus,treat]
A treat has appeared! The cat's ears perk up and she pauses to
observe it carefully. After a moment of deliberation, she rises
gracefully and approaches with measured steps [!speed(fast)]
[!approach(stimulus)] [!animation(cautious_approach)]
[!mood(content)] [!happiness(+10)] [!busy(2.5)]. Her tail swishes
with interest. She crouches low as she nears the treat, then
delicately eats it. This is exactly what she wanted.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:55] [tags:cat,stimulus,ball]
A ball has appeared. The cat glances at it with visible disinterest
[!animation(head_tilt)] [!speed(slow)] [!mood(neutral)]
[!happiness(+1)] [!busy(1.0)]. She may watch briefly from her
current position, perhaps flicking an ear, but makes no enthusiastic
move to approach. Balls are beneath her dignity. She might bat at it
halfheartedly if it's very close, but otherwise she's unmoved.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:82] [tags:cat,stimulus,treat,arrival]
The cat has reached the treat. She crouches low and delicately
nibbles at it [!animation(knead)] [!speed(slow)] [!mood(content)]
[!happiness(+12)] [!effect(sparkles)] [!busy(2.5)]
[!thought(Acceptable.)]. She eats with precise, measured bites —
savoring each one. Her eyes half-close in satisfaction. This is
exactly the kind of offering she expects.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:58] [tags:cat,stimulus,ball,arrival]
The cat has ended up near a ball. She gives it a single disdainful
bat with her paw [!animation(swat_playful)] [!speed(slow)]
[!mood(neutral)] [!happiness(+2)] [!busy(1.0)]. She watches it
roll briefly, unimpressed, then turns away. Beneath her dignity.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:50] [tags:cat,idle,perch]
Nothing interesting is happening. The cat heads toward an elevated
perch [!seek(perch)] [!speed(normal)] [!animation(walk)]
[!mood(content)] [!busy(4.0)]. She doesn't like being out in the
open — she wants to reach a high vantage point where she can survey
the room with quiet authority. She walks with purpose, tail held
upright.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:45] [tags:cat,perch,resting]
The cat is comfortably settled on her perch [!animation(knead)]
[!speed(slow)] [!mood(content)] [!happiness(+2)] [!busy(5.0)].
She surveys the room below with half-closed eyes, occasionally
shifting position or grooming a paw. She radiates calm and
contentment. If something catches her eye below, her ears swivel
to track it, but she doesn't move unless it's truly worthwhile —
like a treat.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:70] [tags:cat,mood,unhappy]
The cat is displeased. Her ears flatten, her tail lashes back and
forth with irritation [!seek(perch)] [!speed(fast)]
[!animation(back_away)] [!mood(annoyed)] [!happiness(-2)]. She
retreats to the highest available perch and hunkers down, glaring
at the world below. She's not interested in anyone's attempts at
interaction right now. Her body language is closed off and
unapproachable.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:60] [tags:cat,mood,happy]
The cat is in an unusually good mood. She's more active than usual,
padding around with her tail held high [!wander] [!speed(normal)]
[!animation(stretch)] [!mood(playful)] [!happiness(+2)]
[!effect(musical_notes)] — the sign of a content cat. She might rub
against objects or even approach a person. Her movements are fluid
and confident. She may even engage in a brief burst of playful
energy, batting at nothing in particular.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:75] [tags:dog,stimulus,ball]
A ball has appeared! The dog's eyes lock onto it immediately. His
whole body tenses with excitement, tail wagging furiously. He charges
toward the ball at full speed [!speed(sprint)] [!approach(stimulus)]
bouncing with barely contained joy [!animation(excited_bounce)]
[!mood(excited)] [!happiness(+10)] [!effect(exclamation)]
[!busy(2.0)]. Nothing can distract him from his favorite thing.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:65] [tags:dog,stimulus,treat]
A treat has appeared. The dog notices it and trots over with moderate
interest [!speed(fast)] [!approach(stimulus)] [!animation(walk)]
[!mood(content)] [!happiness(+5)] [!busy(1.5)]. He enjoys food but
it doesn't drive him wild like a ball does. He approaches at a brisk
pace, sniffs the treat, and eats it contentedly. His tail wags at a
steady rhythm.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:82] [tags:dog,stimulus,ball,arrival]
The dog has reached the ball! He pounces on it with unbridled joy,
grabbing it in his mouth and shaking it back and forth
[!animation(excited_bounce)] [!speed(slow)] [!mood(excited)]
[!happiness(+15)] [!effect(hearts)] [!busy(3.0)]
[!thought(BALL! MY BALL!)]. His tail is a blur, his whole body
wriggles with delight. This is the best moment of his life — again.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:72] [tags:dog,stimulus,treat,arrival]
The dog has reached the treat and wolfs it down happily
[!animation(idle)] [!speed(slow)] [!mood(content)]
[!happiness(+8)] [!busy(1.5)] [!thought(Yum!)]. He sniffs
the spot where the treat was, licking his chops. A satisfied
tail wag follows. Not as exciting as a ball but still a good find.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:40] [tags:dog,idle,wander]
Nothing is happening right now. The dog wanders around the space
[!wander] [!speed(normal)] [!animation(walk)] [!mood(neutral)]
[!busy(2.0)], sniffing the ground, exploring corners, and generally
keeping himself entertained. He moves at a relaxed pace, occasionally
pausing to investigate something interesting on the ground. His tail
sways gently. He might loop back to check on areas he's been before.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:70] [tags:dog,mood,unhappy]
The dog is feeling neglected and sad [!speed(slow)] [!animation(idle)]
[!mood(sleepy)] [!happiness(-2)]. His movements are slower, his tail
droops, and he might lie down or sit in one spot looking forlorn. He
glances around hoping for attention or a ball. His body language shows
obvious unhappiness — lowered head, minimal movement, occasional sighs.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:60] [tags:dog,mood,happy]
The dog is brimming with happiness! He bounces around energetically
[!wander] [!speed(fast)] [!animation(excited_bounce)] [!mood(playful)]
[!happiness(+2)], does little spins, and his tail is a blur of wagging.
Everything seems exciting to him. He might do spontaneous zoomies
across the space, running in quick bursts before circling back. Pure
joy radiates from every movement.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:55] [tags:dog,inter_pet,social,playful]
The dog spots the cat and wants to play! He drops into a play bow —
front legs down, rear up, tail wagging frantically [!approach(pet)]
[!speed(fast)] [!animation(play_bow)] [!mood(playful)]
[!happiness(+5)] [!busy(3.0)]. He bounds toward the cat with clumsy
enthusiasm. His movements are exaggerated and goofy, full of
boundless social energy. Whether the cat tolerates this depends on
her mood.
[DIRECTIVE] [priority:50] [tags:dog,inter_pet,social,cautious]
The dog notices the cat nearby and is curious but hesitant. He
approaches slowly [!approach(pet)] [!speed(slow)]
[!animation(cautious_approach)] [!mood(neutral)] [!happiness(+2)]
[!busy(2.0)], head low, tail wagging tentatively. He stops at a
respectful distance and watches, occasionally tilting his head. He
wants to interact but isn't sure if the cat will accept him right
now.
